name: Ring of the Feather
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 1st; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of feather falling. Once worn, the wearer’s weight becomes negligible. The wearer suffers no damage from falling any distance nor do they activate any traps dependent on the weight of the character. Any amount of wind stronger than a light breeze, however, threatens to blow the wearer off his feet unless the wearer makes a Reflex save as follows:

Wind Strength	Reflex DC
Strong Breeze	15
Light Wind	20
Moderate Wind	25
Strong Wind/Gale	30
Tempest	35

Saving throws made against a gust of wind spell are at a -15 penalty.

The wearer is flung 10 feet in the direction the wind was blowing for every 5 points (rounded up) by which a Reflex saving throw is failed.

Casting remove curse upon the ring allows the wearer to remove it, though the enchantment remains intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of feather falling

Identification DC 26
False Identification DC 16
